content: ort crate v2 has major breaking changes from v1: removed Model Zoo structs, removed Environment-level logging, changed Value::from_array API (no allocator param), new Tensor::new for infallible extraction. Execution providers silently fall back to CPU if unavailable - use ExecutionProvider::cuda().is_available() to check. Session is Send+Sync, wrap in Arc for thread sharing. Prebuilt download strategy only provides CUDA/TensorRT on Windows/Linux.
